patch_description: Avoid copying the large derived state (`coords`, visit flags, and per-cell dirt terms) for every proposed move. Every operation reads route geometry exclusively from `current_pd_obj`, modifies only `candidate_pd_obj.moves`, and then `calculate_score_full` completely reconstructs the candidate coordinates, flags, score, and dirt terms. Copying only the move sequence substantially increases the number of simulated-annealing iterations available within the time limit, especially after routes become long.
